author: Arachadonic
body:
I have seen many people complaining ingame and here on the forums about how a lot of the maps are bad and I have even seen people leave the server if one of these "bad" maps comes up. There also seems to be an issue with an over-population of maps in Nebula and Nexus mainly.

So my solution to this is to make, prehaps a google document (as it is very easy to tally up scores and whatnot), a poll that will have a list of every single map in each gamemode and under the map name you will have 3 options and you must press one of the 3: "Like" "Neutral" "Dislike".

This will enable you to tell exactly which maps people are enjoying and which maps need to go. Also I think maybe include a broadcast ingame that tells people this googledoc will be on the forums so people who play ingame and are not active on the forums can also have a say.
Please share your opinions below!
